scope: Read-only CPU diagnosis of the recorded hazard-contact, ToF-clearance and occlusion stops, with a known-map swept-geometry model (URDF kinematics, the robot's convex link hulls as PhysX uses them, the exported orchard meshes, the recorded settled home). Simulator geometry; not perception; no GPU.
